text:
Omar (Design): Quick feedback from the usability lab - the welcome banner's 'Launch a starter' CTA is getting missed. Screenshot + recording: https://figma.com/file/welcome-compact

Priya (Eng): Do you mean the visual weight is low or placement?

Omar (Design): Both. On 1366x768 the CTA sits under a hero illustration and blends with the background. Thinking stronger contrast + a small inline 'Try sample' pill.

Sam UX: We tried three copy options in the mock: A) 'Create starter project' B) 'Launch a starter' C) 'Try a sample app - one click deploy'. Preference leans toward C for clarity but it's long on mobile.

Nadia (Growth): Activation metric note: longer copy might improve clarity but hurts CTR on mobile due to truncation. Can we A/B test short vs descriptive copy? Metric: activation_day0 and time_to_first_deploy.

Tess (A11y): Accessibility nit - the hero uses decorative SVGs layered above the background, but z-indexing means heading isn't first in DOM order. Ensure heading is semantic H1 and comes earlier in the DOM. Also check focus outline for the new pill.

Priya (Eng): Implementation constraints: we can add a small pill repurposed from our design system. Backend needed: templates manifest endpoint (small JSON ~6KB gzipped) and CDN for starter bundles. Frontend: skeleton tiles + lazy-load blobs. Rough ETA: 3 days infra + 2 days frontend + 1 day QA if no other priorities.

Omar (Design): For the pill, propose: pill label = "Try sample" and microcopy below: "Pre-configured with prompts & deploy script". On mobile, pill shrinks to icon + tooltip.

Sam UX: Also propose a compact carousel variant where users swipe through 3 starters. That keeps the hero short and exposes options. Need to ensure swipe has visible affordance and respects reduced-motion.

Tess (A11y): Carousel accessibility: each slide must be a region with aria-roledescription and keyboard left/right navigation. If we autoplay, obey prefers-reduced-motion and don't auto-advance for screen reader users. Also ensure controls have accessible names like "Previous starter" / "Next starter".

eng-bot: Event created: onboarding.welcome.banner_click with props {variant, copy_variant}.

Priya (Eng): Network note: starter bundles should be <500KB each compressed to avoid cold-start delay. We'll gzip and host on CDN. Manifest will include sizes and checksums.

Nadia (Growth): For the canary, let's gate by new users only and run Variant 1 = pill + microcopy, Variant 2 = carousel, Variant 3 = long copy CTA. Measure activation_day0 and CTR.

Omar (Design): Contrast nit: current gradient overlay uses token #00A38E -> white, fails AA for body text. Options: darken gradient or add translucent dark overlay under text. I'll update Figma with both.

Sam UX: Keyboard focus flow: CTA pill should be tabbable early in the header, and when a starter card receives focus, reveal a small 'Preview' button. Keep focus order linear.

Priya (Eng): Agree. We'll implement skeletons: show 3 empty tiles, fetch manifest, then stream metadata into tiles, fetch bundle on Preview/Launch. Logging: send event onboarding.template.preview and onboarding.template.launch with template_id.

Tess (A11y): Microcopy change suggestion: replace "Preview" with "Preview starter" to be more explicit for screen readers. Also ensure that dismissible elements are labeled "Dismiss welcome".

Omar (Design): Plan: update Figma with pill + carousel mocks, add contrast alternatives and microcopy variants. Can share before EOD.

Priya (Eng): I'll spin up a manifest endpoint branch and post ETA in #eng. If all good we can ship a limited canary in ~1 week.
